hint_begin: Use <A> and <D> to move. <W> to jump, and <S> to attack.
hint_begin_touch: Tap and drag sideways to move. Drag upward to jump, downward to attack.
hint_pickup: I should walk over and learn that skill by pressing <TAB>.
Pressing <TAB> also shows my current list of skills.
hint_pickup_touch: I should walk over and learn that skill by tapping top left screen corner.
It can also show my current list of skills.
